subject: statistics
intro: Statistics leads to the quantitative professions — pricing risk, running surveys, modelling decisions and turning raw numbers into insight across insurance, industry, technology and research.

roles.title: Actuaries
roles.what: Analyse statistical data on mortality, accident, sickness and retirement rates, construct probability tables to forecast risk and liability, and set the insurance rates and reserves an insurer must hold.
roles.where: The probability and probability distributions units — conditional probability, independence, expectation — are the daily arithmetic of actuarial work, backed by the course's habit of questioning data quality and sampling bias.

roles.title: Statisticians
roles.entry: Master's degree (some roles accept a bachelor's degree)
roles.what: Develop and apply statistical theory and methods to collect, organise, interpret and summarise numerical data, producing usable information for science, business and government decisions.
roles.where: This is the syllabus as a job description: sampling methods and bias, measures of central tendency and dispersion, standardised rates, correlation and time series — every unit is a tool statisticians use on real datasets.

roles.title: Operations Research Analysts
roles.what: Formulate and apply mathematical modelling and optimising methods to help management make decisions — solving problems of scheduling, logistics, cost and resource allocation with data.
roles.where: Probability distributions and expectation, index numbers for comparing across years, and time-series trend lines with their stated limitations train the modelling mindset optimisation work is built on.

roles.title: Data Scientists
roles.what: Transform raw data into meaningful information using programming and analytics tools, applying data mining, modelling and visualisation to large datasets and reporting what the findings mean.
roles.where: The representation of data unit — charts, histograms, scatter diagrams and lines of best fit — becomes visualisation practice; correlation versus causation and the limits of trend-line predictions are exactly the scepticism data science demands.

roles.title: Survey Researchers
roles.what: Plan, develop and conduct surveys: decide survey objectives, design questionnaires, test question wording, supervise fieldwork and analyse and interpret the data collected.
roles.where: The Data and its collection unit is this role in miniature — population, sample and census; random, systematic, stratified and quota sampling; bias; and the choice between open and closed questions.
